title: Sunglasses Mask Pad Protective Pad Accessories
body_html:
Product information:
Product selling points:
1. Made of high-quality sponge material, soft and comfortable to wear;
2. Tailored eye mask pads provide precise fit and a more comfortable wearing experience;
3. Comfortable and easy to use, with anti leakage effect, easy to install and replace;
4. When installing, please start from the position of the nose bridge and then install the surrounding face mask, continuously adjusting to achieve better usage effect.

Notes:
1. Please first install the sponge pad at the nose position of the flying glasses, then install the sponge pad around the frame, and adjust the position of the sponge pad to achieve better anti leakage effect and not hinder nose breathing.
2. Due to the different facial shapes of different groups of people, there may be edge light leakage during use. Before use, please adjust the fitting position of the sponge pad to achieve better results.
3. Avoid soaking the sponge pad in water to avoid affecting its service life.

Main material: sponge
